# Fixture provenance

The TypeScript files in this directory are copied verbatim from
[andrewferk/url-shortener](https://github.com/andrewferk/url-shortener) at commit
`ba5870f82b6a9869fc9f98f041a3b11e001354bf` (pull request #100). They are test
fixtures only: the scanner must flag every document-citing comment in them and
leave the two genuine "why" comments alone.
